integrity: The global statements are proved analytically from support functions and spherical conditioning. Numerical quadrature is supplemental only. Literature comparison is limited by indexing and accessible source coverage, with an explicit residual risk for differently phrased prior work.
scientific_limitations: Equal unit disks in perpendicular planes, with centers separated along their common line. The theorem gives derivative laws, strict convexity, monotonicity, and limiting slope; it does not claim a closed form for the mean width at every separation or settle the distinguished two-circle-roller value in closed form.
title: A one-dimensional derivative law for orthogonal-disk mean width
